verbatim_from_methods: The amino acid sequence spanning the type 1 EWSR1-FLI1 fusion breakpoint (EWSR1:Exon 7 - FLI1:Exon 6) was used to generate four overlapping 17-mer peptides by a sliding-window approach, limiting contiguous residues from either fusion partner to a maximum of ten.
To ensure broad applicability, the vaccine was designed without HLA restriction.
The sequences (E1-E4) are listed in Table.
This assay primarily detects functional, non-anergic memory T-cells in an HLA-independent manner.
verbatim_from_results: By month 26, polyfunctional responses were observed against all four peptides (E1-E4), with the strongest response directed against peptide E4 (17.7% of CD4+ T-cells, SI 82.7).
Although a single CD8+ response was transiently detectable, the vaccine-induced immunity was dominated by durable CD4+ T-cell activity.
verbatim_from_discussion: The dominance of CD4+ responses and the relative absence of CD8+ reactivity may reflect the class II binding properties of the selected peptides and limited class I presentation in Ewing sarcoma.

corrections_to_VACCINE_PATH_2.vaccine_path_2_wrote: no class I measurement exists to admit
corrections_to_VACCINE_PATH_2.record_actually_says: 'Although a single CD8+ response was transiently detectable, the vaccine-induced immunity was dominated by durable CD4+ T-cell activity.' The ICS flow panel includes CD8 and both CD4+ and CD8+ subsets were gated.
corrections_to_VACCINE_PATH_2.effect_on_verdict: NONE. The transient CD8+ observation is not tied to a named class I allotype, the assay is explicitly HLA-independent, no peptide is 8-11 residues, and no sequence is recoverable from the body text. The record remains inadmissible on three independent predicates. But 'no class I measurement exists' is over-strong as written: a transient CD8+ observation is reported and should be stated as such.

corrections_to_VACCINE_PATH_2.effect_on_verdict: NONE. The authors hedge ('may reflect'), say 'relative' absence, and offer a second, independent explanation that VACCINE-PATH-2's paraphrase drops.
